title: Trinity B003: TRI-27 ISA — 27-Register Ternary Instruction Set
description:
TRI-27 ISA defines a 27-register balanced ternary instruction set with Coptic 3-bank encoding. Key innovations include: (1) Coptic alphabet for optimal 3-bank access (α-η, ι-ρ, σ-ϡ); (2) 9 registers per bank with sacred naming; (3) 48-bit instruction format with opcode, operands, flags; (4) Complete assembler, emulator, and disassembler toolchain; (5) Verified instruction set with 15/15 tests passing; (6) Zero external dependencies in Zig 0.15.x. Complete reproducibility artifacts including Docker environment, instruction reference, and assembly examples. 

**ISA Specification:**
```
Registers: 27 total (3 banks × 9)
  - Alpha (α-η): R0-R8 (general purpose)
  - Iota (ι-ρ): R9-R17 (function args + saved)
  - Sigma (σ-ϡ): R18-R26 (stack, frame, control)

Instruction Format: 48 bits
  - Opcode: 8 bits (256 opcodes)
  - Operands: 24 bits (up to 3 operands)
  - Flags: 8 bits (condition codes)
  - Reserved: 8 bits
```

**Assembly Example:**
```
  # Sum 1 to 10 and store result
  load r0, #1     ; Load 1 into R0
  load r1, #10    ; Load 10 into R1
loop:  add r0, r1       ; R0 += R1
  dec r1            ; R1 -= 1
  jgt r1, #0, loop  ; Branch to loop if R1 > 0
  store r0, #10    ; Store result in R10
  halt               ; Stop
```

**Test Coverage:** 15/15 unit tests passing (100%)
references: Ma et al., The Era of 1-bit LLMs: All Large Language Models are in 1.58 Bits, arXiv:2402.17764 (2024)
Patterson, RISC-V: A Modular ISA, arXiv:1610.00179 (2016)
